name.local: 之初創投 / 之初加速器

check_size.raw: seed ~US$50,000–US$200,000; growth-stage (Series A–C) starting at US$2 million

strategy.thesis: Largest software accelerator and VC in Greater Southeast Asia, anchored on three investment themes: Southeast Asia, blockchain, and artificial intelligence. Backs founders both through its accelerator and through direct growth-stage venture funds.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to the AppWorks Accelerator (twice-yearly batches) or pitch the fund directly.

summary.en: Founded in 2010, AppWorks is Asia's leading startup accelerator and a multi-stage VC headquartered in Taipei, with US$212M AUM across three funds and an ecosystem of 400+ active startups. Fund III ($150M, 2021) focuses on Taiwan and Southeast Asia, blockchain, and AI.
summary.local: 之初創投（AppWorks）成立於 2010 年，是亞洲領先的創業加速器與多階段創投，總部位於台北，旗下三檔基金管理規模達 2.12 億美元，生態系匯聚超過 400 家活躍新創。第三檔基金（1.5 億美元，2021 年）聚焦台灣與東南亞、區塊鏈與 AI。

strategy.thesis: Global pre-seed and seed-stage fund investing in pre-product/market-fit startups, operated on a Solo GP model; one of the few Asian VCs to break into Silicon Valley.

summary.en: Cherubic Ventures (心元資本) is a Taipei-founded global seed-stage VC (Solo GP model) led by Matt Cheng, with US$462M AUM, 200+ portfolio companies, and an aggregate portfolio valuation exceeding US$52 billion. Backers include Hims & Hers, Flexport, Paidy, Calm, and 91APP.
summary.local: 心元資本（Cherubic Ventures）由鄭博仁（Matt Cheng）於台北創立，採 Solo GP 模式的全球種子期創投，總管理資產 4.62 億美元，投資超過 200 家新創，整體投資組合估值突破 520 億美元，代表案例包括 Hims & Hers、Flexport、Paidy、Calm 與 91APP。

strategy.thesis: Government-and-private-backed flagship VC (40% owned by Taiwan's National Development Fund) connecting Taiwanese technology and capital with global markets; invests in tech (IoT, semiconductors, AI) and biotech.

summary.en: Taiwania Capital (台杉投資), established in August 2017 and 40% owned by Taiwan's National Development Fund, is the island's flagship public-private VC with US$865M–US$1B AUM across six funds spanning tech (IoT, semiconductors, AI) and biotech, with offices in Taipei and Silicon Valley.
summary.local: 台杉投資成立於 2017 年 8 月，由行政院國家發展基金（持股 40%）與民間企業共同創立，是台灣旗艦級公私合資創投，旗下六檔基金管理規模約 8.65 億至 10 億美元，橫跨科技（物聯網、半導體、AI）與生技領域，於台北與矽谷設有據點。

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's pioneer development-finance institution turned private-equity/VC group (part of KGI Financial Group); invests across venture, growth capital, healthcare, buyout and special situations spanning advanced manufacturing, consumer, tech/AI and healthcare.

summary.en: CDIB Capital Group (中華開發資本), part of KGI Financial Group, is one of Taiwan's largest and most established PE/VC platforms with NT$85B+ AUM, 65+ years of investment heritage, 250+ portfolio companies and 100+ investment professionals across venture, growth, healthcare and special-situations strategies.
summary.local: 中華開發資本（CDIB Capital Group）為凱基金控旗下成員，是台灣規模最大、歷史最悠久的私募股權/創投平台之一，管理資產逾新台幣 850 億元，擁有逾 65 年投資經驗、超過 250 家被投公司與逾 100 位投資專業人員，策略涵蓋創投、成長資本、醫療保健與特殊機會。

summary.en: Hotung Investment (和通), established in 1987 and listed on SGX, is one of Taiwan's oldest and largest venture/PE groups, having invested in 700+ companies (portfolio value >US$5B) with 200+ IPO/M&A exits — including 38 Nasdaq/NYSE listings — across Greater China, Silicon Valley and Israel.
summary.local: 和通創投（Hotung Investment）成立於 1987 年並於新加坡證交所掛牌，是台灣歷史最悠久、規模最大的創投/私募股權集團之一，累計投資逾 700 家公司（投資組合價值逾 50 億美元），逾 200 件 IPO/併購出場（含 38 家於 Nasdaq/NYSE 上市），布局橫跨大中華、矽谷與以色列。

strategy.thesis: Largest VC entity by managed fund size in Taiwan's VC association (TVCA), with deep roots in optoelectronics, IC design and key electronic components, now focused on technology, healthcare, green energy and the digital economy. Strong shareholder base of 14 major insurers and 11 major securities firms.

summary.en: TOP TAIWAN (益鼎創投), founded in 1996, manages over NT$12 billion across 17 funds and has invested in 500+ companies — ranked #1 by managed fund size in Taiwan's VC association. It focuses on technology, healthcare, green energy and the digital economy, backed by 14 major insurers and 11 securities firms.
summary.local: 益鼎創投（TOP TAIWAN）成立於 1996 年，旗下 17 檔基金管理規模超過新台幣 120 億元，投資超過 500 家企業，居創投公會排名第一、為國內最大創投事業體，聚焦科技、醫療、綠能與數位經濟，主要投資人涵蓋台灣 14 家大型保險公司與 11 家大型綜合證券公司。

strategy.thesis: Founded by Acer founder Stan Shih and former Acer senior management; manages venture, incubation/post-incubation, reengineering and branding funds, applying corporate-builder expertise to back technology startups.

summary.en: iD SoftCapital Group (智融集團), established by Acer founder Stan Shih and ex-Acer executives after his end-2004 retirement, manages US$664M AUM (US$832M total fund size) across venture, incubation, reengineering and branding funds, backing technology startups in Taiwan and the US.
summary.local: 智融集團（iD SoftCapital）由宏碁創辦人施振榮於 2004 年底退休後與宏碁前高階主管共同成立，管理資產達 6.64 億美元（總基金規模 8.32 億美元），涵蓋創投、育成/育成後、再造與品牌等基金，投資台灣與美國的科技新創。

strategy.thesis: Long-established Taipei tech VC (since 2009) investing across angel, seed and Series A/B+ stages in Taiwan, Japan and the US; known for consumer-internet and lifestyle-tech bets and for backing spinouts from Taiwan's research institutions.

summary.en: Darwin Ventures (達盈), founded in Taipei in 2009, is a long-running tech VC that has raised 6 funds (latest NT$750M, ~1/3 from the National Development Fund), investing US$1–2M per deal from angel through Series A/B+ across Taiwan, Japan and the US.
